record: Kansas Historical Society Fort Hays exhibits
facts: Four original buildings and a modern visitor center survive at the current site. The two officers houses have timber frames, two-story front blocks and one-story dining and kitchen wings. The guardhouse is 100 by 24 feet. The blockhouse is hexagonal with a radius of 17 feet and opposing 17 foot square wings.
The blockhouse and guardhouse survived at the historic site. The two officers houses were brought back in 1964 and 1987.
The landmark consists of buildings from the 1867 to 1889 post, and the blockhouse has been restored.

record: Historic American Buildings Survey KS-58-A reference catalog
facts: The surviving blockhouse was surveyed by HABS as a stone building. The original survey record identifies its location at the historic park.
